description: Synthetic per-retailer logistics assumptions for the fixture-mode basket comparison: typical delivery-day estimates and shipping geography for the three invented fixture retailers. Every number is a fixture placeholder rendered as a LABELED ASSUMPTION, never a delivery promise; no real retailer or carrier is represented.

provenance.limitations: Synthetic fixture delivery estimates for the validation beta. These are labeled assumptions for feasibility math only — never a delivery promise, never verified against any carrier or retailer.
